room_rent.note: Room Rent, Boarding, Nursing Expenses up to 1% of Sum Insured per day

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges up to 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment on every claim; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern Treatments capped at 50% of Sum Insured; Room rent and ICU also sub-limited

deductible.note: No inbuilt deductible; optional deductible of ₹25,000 / ₹50,000 / ₹1L / ₹2L available on aggregate basis

ped_waiting.note: 36 months for all pre-existing conditions other than HIV/AIDS and Disability; 24 months for pre-existing disability covered under the policy

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions including cataract, hernia, ENT disorders, varicose veins, calculi, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration or reset benefit mentioned in the policy

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses for 30 days prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses for 60 days from date of discharge

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; indicative list of 537+ procedures provided

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursed up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic, IONM, stem cell, etc.) covered up to 50% of Sum Insured

consumables.note: Non-payable consumables list (Annexure II) explicitly excluded; gloves, masks, etc. not covered

global_cover.note: Medical treatment outside India explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years no look-back except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual premium; 15 days for monthly/quarterly/half-yearly modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals

portability.note: Portability to same product of other insurers as per IRDAI guidelines; waiting period credit given

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary treatment, OPD, overseas treatment, organ donor, ART for HIV, prosthetics for disability, STDs, stem cell storage, alternative therapies

optional_riders.display: Co-payment waiver (waives 20% copay); Deductible option (₹25K/₹50K/₹1L/₹2L aggregate)
